exercises.question: Which sentence gives a cause?
options: El problema existe porque falta información. [The problem exists because there is a lack of information.]
El problema será menor si trabajamos juntos. [The problem will be smaller if we work together.]
Quizá exista otro problema en la oficina. [Perhaps there is another problem in the office.]

exercises.sentence: Por eso, es necesario que ___ una solución.
exercises.english: Therefore, it is necessary that we look for a solution.
The consequence is that some families lose time.

sentences: Primero, explico la causa: falta información. [First, I explain the cause: there is a lack of information.]
Después, describo la consecuencia: la gente pierde tiempo. [Then I describe the consequence: people lose time.]
Finalmente, propongo mejorar la comunicación. [Finally, I propose improving communication.]

exercises.question: Which word means «solution»?
options: solución [solution]
consecuencia [consequence]
problema [problem]

exercises.english: It is necessary that we work together.

exercises.sentence: El problema existe porque falta información.
options: The problem exists because there is a lack of information.
The problem exists although there is enough information.
The problem will disappear when there is information.

exercises.sentence: Por eso, es necesario que busquemos una solución.
options: Therefore, it is necessary that we look for a solution.
Therefore, we found a good solution together.
It is possible that there is no solution for us.

exercises.sentence: Algunas familias llegan tarde porque el transporte no funciona bien.
exercises.english: Some families arrive late because the transport doesn't work well.

template.prompt: Say that the problem exists because information is missing.
template.answer: El problema existe porque falta información.

template.prompt: Say that the consequence is that some people lose time.
template.answer: La consecuencia es que algunas personas pierden tiempo.

template.prompt: Say that it is necessary that we look for a solution and that you think this proposal can help.
template.answer: Es necesario que busquemos una solución y creo que esta propuesta puede ayudar.
